metadata.title: Remote Sensing Scientist Academy
metadata.description: Practical online remote sensing training with real satellite data, clear workflows, and portfolio projects.

hero.title: Learn remote sensing.
hero.intro: A practical online academy for people who want to understand satellite data and use it with confidence. You will learn by doing, from the basics to a complete analysis.

pathsSection.summary: Take one focused program or complete all three to build the full set of remote sensing skills.

items.label: FOUNDATIONS
items.title: Earth Observation Essentials
items.description: Learn how sensors work, how resolutions differ, and what the values in each pixel mean.

items.label: ANALYSIS
items.title: Geospatial Data Science
items.description: Use Python and cloud tools to turn raw satellite scenes into clear, reproducible results.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.title: Climate Intelligence
items.description: Track environmental change, measure risk, and explain your findings in a way people can use.

fieldLab.title: Track recovery after a fire.
fieldLab.lead: In this field lab, you will use Sentinel-2 images to track recovery over several years. You will find where vegetation is returning and where it is not.

steps.title: Prepare the data
steps.description: Select, filter, mask, and align six years of surface reflectance.

steps.title: Measure the change
steps.description: Compare burn severity and vegetation recovery over time.

steps.title: Explain the result
steps.description: Check uncertainty and present a short, clear scientific briefing.

modules.title: Understand the image
modules.description: Learn how sensors collect data, how the atmosphere affects it, and what is inside an Earth observation product.

modules.title: Build the workflow
modules.description: Find the right data, prepare it, calculate indices, classify land cover, and check your results.

modules.title: Present a useful result
modules.description: Create a complete monitoring project and explain the result, including what is certain and what is not.

outcomes.title: Show your work, not only a certificate.
outcomes.description: You will leave with a reviewed portfolio, a repeatable workflow, and the confidence to explain your results clearly.

application.title: Ready to start?
application.description: Send a short note about what you want to learn and why you want to join.

footer.description: Practical remote sensing training with real data and clear results.
